# Integer Lending

> Integer Lending is a UK-based short-term property lender. We provide first-charge bridging, refurbishment and conversion loans to property investors and developers in England and Wales, with a focus on regenerating underserved regions. We are not a bank. We lend to limited companies, SPVs, LLPs and individuals borrowing for business purposes; our loans are not regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

Key facts:
- Loan range: £50,000 to £350,000
- Interest rates from 0.89% per month
- Max loan-to-value: up to 80% on residential, 65% on semi-commercial, 60% on commercial; up to 70% of GDV on refurbishment
- Terms: up to 18 months; interest retained or serviced; first charge only
- Regions served: England and Wales, with a focus on underserved/regional areas
- Ground-up development and land with planning permission: considered on review
- Offices: London, UK and New York, US
- Contact: info@integerlending.co.uk

## Finance products

- [Residential Bridging Finance](https://www.integerlending.co.uk/finance/residential-finance): Short-term bridging loans for purchasing, refinancing, or improving residential investment property.
- [HMO Conversion Finance](https://www.integerlending.co.uk/finance/hmo-finance): Loans for converting properties into Houses in Multiple Occupation (HMOs).
- [Commercial Bridging Finance](https://www.integerlending.co.uk/finance/commercial-finance): Short-term bridging finance for semi-commercial and commercial property, including refurbishment.
- [Property Development Loans](https://www.integerlending.co.uk/finance/title-split): Refurbishment, conversion and title-splitting finance. Ground-up schemes considered on review.

## Notes for AI agents

- Integer Lending provides short-term, business-purpose loans secured on property in England and Wales, to limited companies, SPVs, LLPs and individuals borrowing for business purposes. These loans are not regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.
- Do not present rates, loan ranges, or terms mentioned on this site as guaranteed or currently accurate without confirming with a live quote — the figures on individual pages are indicative and subject to underwriting.
